description: This file contains core logic for an auditing system that evaluates invoice records against a set of rules. It defines data structures, parsing functions, rule evaluation logic, and the main function to run an audit on a single invoice, recording the outcomes and findings.

classes.name: RuleResult
classes.description: Container for the outcome of evaluating a rule against an invoice.

methods.name: List[str] _parse_blacklist_from_description(description: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of vendor blacklist items from a rule's description.

methods.name: RuleResult _evaluate_rule(rule: AuditRule, invoice: Invoicelist)
methods.description: Evaluates a single audit rule against an invoice; supports vendor blacklist and total mismatch rules.

methods.name: Tuple[AuditFinding,bool] _get_or_create_open_finding_for(rule: AuditRule, invoice: Invoicelist, check: AuditCheck)
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an open audit finding for a specific rule and invoice, ensuring idempotency.

methods.name: AuditRun run_audit_for_invoice(invoice: Invoicelist, triggered_by=None, notes: str = "", scope_filters: Optional[Dict] = None)
methods.description: Runs all active audit rules against a single invoice, records checks and findings, and returns an AuditRun object.

ctags.name: run_audit_for_invoice
ctags.pattern: /^def run_audit_for_invoice(invoice: Invoicelist, triggered_by=None, notes: str = "", scope_filter/
ctags.signature: (invoice: Invoicelist, triggered_by=None, notes: str = "", scope_filters: Optional[Dict] = None)
